items.name: CrowdStrike
items.headline: Agrees to acquire Zscaler and reports Q3 FY2027 results
items.catalyst: Q3 FY2027 results and Zscaler acquisition announcement (Nov. 23).
items.thesis: CrowdStrike reported Q3 FY2027 revenue of $1.58 billion and ending ARR of $6.26 billion, and announced an all-stock agreement to acquire Zscaler at approximately $43.9 billion. The company also raised its fiscal 2027 guidance.
items.source_name: CrowdStrike and Zscaler joint press release (SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1)

items.name: Zscaler
items.headline: Agrees to be acquired by CrowdStrike at 1.135 shares per share
items.thesis: Zscaler holders would receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per share, an implied value of about $260.41 per share and a premium of approximately 34% based on Nov. 20 closing prices as stated in the release. Closing is subject to Zscaler shareholder and regulatory approvals.
items.source_name: CrowdStrike and Zscaler joint press release (SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1)

items.name: DoorDash
items.headline: Adds $1.792B term loan and upsizes revolver to $3.5B for Instacart deal
items.thesis: DoorDash raised its revolving commitments by $1.5 billion to $3.5 billion and entered a $1.792 billion delayed draw term loan tied to its pending Maplebear (Instacart) acquisition. It also reduced its bridge commitments from $13.0 billion to $11.208 billion.
